title: Delusional Mind
description:
Step into a twisted psychological horror experience where you must uncover the dark secrets of an abandoned hospital and face nightmarish monsters!

Delusional Mind includes:

• First-person survival horror with puzzle-solving and intense combat.

• Immersive storyline filled with mystery, psychological horror, and supernatural elements.

• Exploration and crafting to survive the haunted environments.

• Jump scares and eerie atmosphere that keep you on edge.

description_short: Investigate an abandoned psycho hospital in this first-person survival horror. Fight terrifying monsters, solve puzzles, and uncover dark secrets in a story-driven, adrenaline-pumping experience filled with jump scares and mysteries.
